sloka: श्यमा पद्म पलाशाक्षी प्रिया विरहिता मया ।कथम् धरयति प्राणान् विवशा जनकात्मजा ॥४-१-१०५॥
transliteration: śyamā padma palāśākṣī priyā virahitā mayā ।katham dharayati prāṇān vivaśā janakātmajā ॥4-1-105॥

translations.english: 'How can Janaka's daughter with eyes like lotus petals, so young and loving, sustain her life? Away from me, she must be feeling quite dejected.
